description: This file contains Redux action creators for managing integrations such as webhooks, commands, OAuth apps, and interactive dialogs in Mattermost. It includes functions for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and handling OAuth connections, as well as submitting and looking up interactive dialogs.

methods.name: createIncomingHook
methods.description: Creates a new incoming webhook using the provided hook data.

methods.name: getIncomingHook
methods.description: Retrieves an incoming webhook by its ID.

methods.name: getIncomingHooks
methods.description: Fetches a list of incoming webhooks for a team, with optional pagination and total count.

methods.name: isIncomingWebhooksWithCount
methods.description: Type guard to check if data includes total_count and incoming_webhooks array.

methods.name: removeIncomingHook
methods.description: Deletes an incoming webhook by its ID.

methods.name: updateIncomingHook
methods.description: Updates an existing incoming webhook.

methods.name: createOutgoingHook
methods.description: Creates a new outgoing webhook.

methods.name: getOutgoingHook
methods.description: Retrieves an outgoing webhook by its ID.

methods.name: getOutgoingHooks
methods.description: Fetches outgoing webhooks for a channel and team, with pagination.

methods.name: removeOutgoingHook
methods.description: Deletes an outgoing webhook by its ID.

methods.name: updateOutgoingHook
methods.description: Updates an existing outgoing webhook.

methods.name: regenOutgoingHookToken
methods.description: Regenerates the token for an outgoing webhook.

methods.name: getCommands
methods.description: Retrieves command list for a team.

methods.name: getAutocompleteCommands
methods.description: Retrieves autocomplete commands for a team.

methods.name: getCustomTeamCommands
methods.description: Fetches custom commands for a team.

methods.name: addCommand
methods.description: Adds a new command.

methods.name: editCommand
methods.description: Edits an existing command.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments.

methods.name: regenCommandToken
methods.description: Regenerates the token for a command.

methods.name: deleteCommand
methods.description: Deletes a command by ID.

methods.name: addOAuthApp
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth application.

methods.name: editOAuthApp
methods.description: Edits an existing OAuth application.

methods.name: getOAuthApps
methods.description: Retrieves list of OAuth applications.

methods.name: getOutgoingOAuthConnections
methods.description: Fetches outgoing OAuth connections for a team.

methods.name: getOutgoingOAuthConnectionsForAudience
methods.description: Fetches outgoing OAuth connections for a specific audience.

methods.name: addOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Creates a new outgoing OAuth connection.

methods.name: editOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Edits an outgoing OAuth connection.

methods.name: getOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Retrieves an outgoing OAuth connection by ID.

methods.name: validateOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Validates an outgoing OAuth connection.

methods.name: getAppsOAuthAppIDs
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of OAuth apps.

methods.name: getAppsBotIDs
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of bot applications.

methods.name: getOAuthApp
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific OAuth app.

methods.name: getAuthorizedOAuthApps
methods.description: Fetches OAuth apps authorized by the current user.

methods.name: deauthorizeOAuthApp
methods.description: Deauthorizes an OAuth app.

methods.name: deleteOAuthApp
methods.description: Deletes an OAuth application.

methods.name: regenOAuthAppSecret
methods.description: Regenerates the secret for an OAuth app.

methods.name: deleteOutgoingOAuthConnection
methods.description: Deletes an outgoing OAuth connection.

methods.name: submitInteractiveDialog
methods.description: Submits an interactive dialog with current channel, team, and user context.

methods.name: lookupInteractiveDialog
methods.description: Looks up items for an interactive dialog.
